titulo: Outcry in Trinidad and Tobago after passing of police bill that could threaten press freedom
cuerpo: Journalists call for urgent amendment to special operations bill, which increases police search and seizure powers Journalists in Trinidad and Tobago have called for an urgent amendment to a sweeping new bill that increases police powers of search and seizure, which they argue threatens the country’s much-vaunted freedom of the press. The government says the special operations bill 2026 , passed on 24 September, is designed to tackle alarmingly high crime and murder rates in the Caribbean nation. Continue reading...
